cases.name: condition-reevaluated
cases.body:
var i=0
var n=0
while(i<3){i++
if(i==2){n+=10}else{n+=1}}
return n
cases.cs: int i=0,n=0; while(i<3){i++; if(i==2)n+=10; else n+=1;} return n;

cases.name: continue-rechecks
cases.cs: int i=0,n=0; while(i<4){i++; if(i==2)continue; n++;} return n;
